track: Track C: Contrastive Speech Analytics & Temporal Flaw Grounding
description: Ground-truth temporal flaw annotations and acoustic metadata for pair-wise contrastive speech analysis.
target_script: Good communication is important for success. When we speak clearly, people understand our ideas. We should control our pace, pause at the right moment, and speak with confidence.

flaw_annotations.causal_explanation: Speaker pauses mid-predicate ('Good communication is... [pause] important').
Disrupted articulation stumble before concluding the word 'success'.
Rapid syllable cluster (16 words delivered at ~348 WPM with compressed clause pauses).
Prolonged mid-phrase hesitation break (>700ms) interrupting the final clause transition.

provenance_and_limitations.speaker_demographics: Single adult male demonstration speaker recorded in a controlled interior acoustic environment.
provenance_and_limitations.capture_hardware: Android smartphone built-in microphone (AAC stereo, 48 kHz).
provenance_and_limitations.intended_purpose: Designed as a controlled reference pair demonstrating contrastive acoustic measurements and temporal flaw grounding.
limitations: Small sample size (N=2 recordings, single speaker) does not constitute a generalized multi-speaker population dataset.
Acoustic features are physical signals (RMS energy, F0, MFCCs) and do not evaluate rhetorical skill, emotional truth, or linguistic semantics.
Ground truth flaw intervals are human-annotated reference boundaries for evaluation and sanity checking.
